This enables one to deliver timing exten- sions in a separate document. In addition, there are no external references from any template that point to timing extensions elements.

Optionality of Timing Extensions To maintain it's optional use in the AUTOSAR methodology, TIMEX always references "outwards" towards other external (i.e. in other template specifications) model elements.
